purpose: Stage 4 V0 Trusted Computing Base and explicit limitations. Every assurance claim in this archive rests on these.

trusted_computing_base.trusted_for: correct execution of all scripts/*.py governance logic, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, contextlib

os.link atomicity (write-once artifacts), directory rename/replace atomicity, byte-range advisory lock ownership and release-on-process-death (msvcrt.locking on Windows, fcntl.flock on POSIX), durability of written JSON across a process restart

worktree isolation facts (rev-parse / status / cat-file / worktree list), local snapshot commits authored by obsidia_mission_local_snapshot_v0, branch/base identity checks. Git is a DISPOSITION/INTEGRATION record, never governance authority.

execution_authority_hash, plan_hash, hma_record_hash, daaw_record_hash, dmae_record_hash, approval_record_hash, decision_record_hash, revocation_record_hash, all *_id derivations (id = 'prefix-' + sha256(bound_material)[:32]). In Lean this is the CryptoInterface hypothesis bundle (not an axiom); FORMAL sha256 byte-equivalence is NOT claimed.
deterministic bound-material serialization so that record hashes are reproducible and tamper-evident

trusted_computing_base.component: GuardX108 / KX108 kernel + evidence adapters (sigma protocols)
trusted_computing_base.trusted_for: the sovereign KX108_PRE and KX108_POST decisions and their evidence translation. Stage 4 does NOT modify KX108 kernel semantics; it feeds evidence and consumes the gate.
the single governed target write, pre-state / drift double-check, SealedRollbackEvidence built+verified before the write, post-write measurement, rollback D2
serialization of revocation commit vs Stage 4 governed mutation via a mission_id-keyed OS lock; bounded timeout -> fail-closed; released in finally + on process death

different Stage 4 executions run in distinct OS processes / threads that share only the filesystem; the concurrency claims assume the OS lock is the only coordination and that a crashed holder's lock is released by the OS

trusted_computing_base.component: Lean 4 kernel + elaborator + toolchain (lake) + Mathlib core (propext etc.)
trusted_computing_base.trusted_for: the 16 machine-checked invariant theorems + the 2nd central theorem being valid, axiom-free proofs; the decide-based 4D oracle's evaluation

that the Python CanonicalVector projection used by test_mission_authority_conformance_v0.py faithfully represents the same scenario given to the Lean oracle; validated only over the 17 semantic + 11 scope canonical vectors, NOT universally
that the 17 Lean *Spec definitions actually capture the intended safety properties of bounded mission authority; this is a modelling assumption, not a proven fact

limitations.central_theorem_17_end_to_end: NOT_YET_PROVEN (finite canonical fixture + single-operation domain + documented TCB only)
limitations.universal_runtime_refinement: NOT_PROVEN (Lean<->runtime conformance validated over a finite vector corpus)
limitations.op_expansion_conformance_vector: NOT_REPRESENTABLE at V0 (Lean Operation has one constructor)
limitations.concurrency_model: V0 property is a total serialized COMMIT order between a canonically committed revocation and a governed mutation; a revocation REQUEST arriving after the executor owns the lock does NOT retroactively cancel an already-linearized action
limitations.claude_transport_only_enforcement: NOT technically enforced; tool-permission / gateway enforcement is a separate future checkpoint
limitations.human_authorization_scope: O(1) applies ONLY to a fixed exact bounded plan (exact plan_hash); NOT a claim of general or unrestricted autonomy
limitations.kx_complexity: KX108_PRE and KX108_POST remain O(N) by design; there is deliberately no mission-level KX blanket authority
limitations.repair_loop: no automatic repair / retry loop is introduced by Stage 4; a governed non-KEEP or quarantine stops the mission fail-closed
limitations.trust_boundary_of_stores: whoever can write the mission store / execution store / decision stores is inside the trust boundary; the forgery defences (Fix A) require a self-consistent canonical DMAE->HMA->DAAW chain that exact-binds the execution, which a store-writer could in principle fabricate wholesale; the pre-mutation FULL canonical checks dominate and any such fabrication is a full mission reconstruction, not a lightweight forgery

claim_boundary_statement: Core bounded mission authority invariants are machine-checked in Lean (16/17 invariant specs + the 2nd central theorem, axiom-free). Canonical representable semantics are validated against runtime vectors (17 semantic + 11 scope pairs, 0 divergence). Bounded multi-action Stage 4 execution (A -> B -> C) has been empirically validated against positive, negative, replay, revocation (sequential and concurrent-linearized), restart/resume and rollback tests, with a mechanical mutation-to-witness map showing 0 unaccounted mutations, under the documented V0 TCB and the single-operation (UPDATE_TARGET_FROM_SOURCE) domain. Obsidia Stage 4 is NOT claimed to be 'formally proven secure'.
